adaptation.method: per-action contact-aware retargeting; no global pose scale
requiredChanges: Source pelvis y=0.884 at neutral is 79.5 mm below current reset; begin by lifting neutral pelvis by the measured v2-to-armfix reset delta +0.063970 m, preserving the old 15.555 mm intentional flexion offset.
This neutral correction alone does not preserve bottom-knee clearance; solve pelvis depth/backward shift per phase from current two-bone lengths and actual ankle targets.
Preserve toe landing through actual current shoe toe-to-ankle offset; source toeDz hardcodes 0.16 m forward/0.075 m below.
Hands palmAt are hips-frame surface targets: remap by trunk geometry, not by arm-length scaling.
adaptation.handAcceptance: This action has not been visually inspected with the selected body/hand setup.
adaptation.implemented: Raised neutral pelvis to current standing baseline; retained low-pose root height by increasing depth travel. Hip hand targets follow current rest pelvis; bottom clearance needs GPU check.
adaptation.rotationPolicy: Full forearm axial sharing avoids half-angle +/-pi branch flips; actual-render rotation and visible deformation checks remain required.
adaptation.visualCorrection: Add up to12mm pelvis softening only during stepping transition to avoid four ankle reach clamp frames; endpoints and depth unchanged.

reviewPlan.primaryView: Keep the source side-three-quarter direction to show step-back distance and knee bend on both sides.
checks: Each foot steps back once; front heel stays planted and back toe remains fixed after landing.
Back knee hovers at the bottom and both legs return to an intentional upright stance.
Hands stay on hips; side-front view separates knees and shows step length.
Inspect actual wrist and ankle quaternion paths at every frame, not only endpoint directions: shortest consecutive rotation, total turn, hand/sole facing, left/right consistency and loop seam.
reviewPlan.contentBounds: union of visible body and necessary props over all output frames; one rectangle for the whole clip
reviewPlan.groundProps: Keep necessary support mat/wall/cushion as explicit props; exclude shadow/stage helpers.

limits: This checks authored descriptor vectors and raw foot angles. It does not measure actual wrist/ankle bone quaternions, IK pole branch changes or skinned twists.
Large raw Euler angles or identical endpoint orientations alone do not establish a defect. Root GPU capture must inspect actual continuous rotations.

risks: Original hip-touch bisection remains unchanged and is not accepted as true native palm contact.
Both four-second sides, toe compensation, knee hover and return need GPU review.
Current body retains v3 legs/trunk; changing the runtime label alone does not retarget old absolute coordinates.
Support, relaxed, assist and non-dumbbell native grips require their own rendered checks; fixed dumbbell acceptance does not apply.

appearance.purpose: Visual cue for target muscle effort, not a physiological measurement
